sealed: Written and committed before src/withhold.mjs, its tests, the hook's withhold list, examples/withhold or tools/measure-7.mjs existed. Disclosed: designed after a buyer walk read the page's own security section, which says the recorder copies every file the agent reads into .acg, secret files included, and offers only 'keep .acg out of version control'. tools/measure-7.mjs refuses to run if this file differs from the commit that sealed it. A claim that fails is kept.
what: Organ 7, a withhold list. A file named in .acg/withhold is kept out of .acg: when Claude Code's file tools read, write or edit it, the recorder keeps no copy of it, no hash of its bytes and no hash of the tool input that carried it; the record names it as an artifact not stored, so P7 fails at that entry and a reviewer sees that an input was withheld. A line with no '/' matches the name of the file or of any folder on its path; a line with a '/' matches the path from the project's folder (a leading '/' is ignored); '*' is any run of characters but '/', '?' one character but '/', '**' any run including '/'; letters match regardless of case; a backslash counts as '/'; blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored. A starter list of common secret files ships as examples/withhold, to copy. With no list, the recorder does exactly what organ 2 measured. A list that exists but cannot be read fails closed: every file is withheld.
seenBefore: Organ 2's receipt and the page's security section: the store keeps a copy of each file read or written, named by its hash, that includes any secret file the agent reads.
scope: The recorder's file copies and hashes only. A shell command's output is not captured at all (only a hash of the command), and an imported transcript keeps no files, so neither changes. It keeps a secret out of the record; it does not stop the agent reading the file or sending it anywhere.

claims.claim: Over 50 jobs driven through acg hook with examples/withhold copied into .acg/withhold, each job sealed first and then reading, writing and editing files on and off the list, every file carrying a unique marker: after acg record for each job, no file under .acg holds the marker of any withheld file, the SHA-256 of its bytes, or the SHA-256 of a tool input that named it.

In those 50 jobs, each record lists every withheld file as an artifact with stored false and a hash that is not the SHA-256 of its bytes; P7 fails, pointing at exactly the withheld files; P0, the strict schema, passes; and every file not on the list is stored, its copy byte for byte the file.

The same 50 jobs with no withhold list: every file is stored, its copy byte for byte the file, with stored true in the record, and the search of W1 finds the marker of every file that W1 withheld, so the search can see what it looks for.

withheld() in src/withhold.mjs agrees with a separately written reference matcher (recursive, character by character, in tools/measure-7.mjs) on 5,000 random pairs of pattern and path drawn from an alphabet that includes the wildcards, slashes, backslashes, dots, mixed case and the characters a regular expression treats as special; and parseWithhold() and withheld() never throw on 2,000 garbage inputs of every type.

A withhold list that exists but cannot be read (a folder where the file should be) fails closed: over 10 jobs, the hook keeps no copy of any file and every artifact in the record is not stored, it exits 0 and prints nothing at every event, and errors.log names the withhold list.
